description_en: Search for media assets that meet the conditions based on the parameters provided by the User
description_zh: 根据用户所给参数，搜索符合条件的媒资
kebab_example: aliyun ice search-public-media-info --media-ids 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000,000015d4a4b0448391508f2cb4860000 --dynamic-meta-data-match-fields ApprovalStatus=_Available_amp_MaterialBags=_boutiquemusic_amp_Mood=_Nervous --favorite true --authorized true --sort-by UsageCount:Desc,UnitPrice:Asc --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --entity-id Copyright_Music --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchPublicMediaInfo

parameters.help_en:
IMS media asset IDs.

Separate multiple IDs with commas
parameters.help_zh:
IMS媒资ID。
多个用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: media_ids

parameters.help_zh: 动态元数据搜索匹配条件
parameters.name: dynamic_meta_data_match_fields

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the User has collected this media asset
parameters.help_zh: 用户是否收藏了该媒资
parameters.name: favorite

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the User has purchased a resource plan that includes this media asset
parameters.help_zh: 用户是否已购买了包含此媒资的资源包
parameters.name: authorized

parameters.help_en:
Result sorting method: :. Valid values:

field:

"UsageCount": usage

"UnitPrice": unit price

order:

"Desc": descending

"Asc": ascending
parameters.help_zh:
结果排序方式 <field>:<order>。取值范围：

field:
"UsageCount" 使用量
"UnitPrice" 单价

order:
"Desc" 倒序
"Asc" 正序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
Entity ID, used to identify different types of public copyright media assets. Valid values:

Copyright_Music: Public copyright music
parameters.help_zh:
实体ID，用来标识不同种类的公共版权媒资。取值：
Copyright_Music: 公共版权音乐
parameters.name: entity_id
